evidence: historical benchmark + derived assumptions (NOT measured by this project)

benchmark.name: SemiAnalysis InferenceX, gpt-oss-120b, 8k input / 1k output, fp4 (read 2026-10-30)
benchmark.interpretation: 'tok/s/chip' counts input+output tokens per GPU; 'concurrency' is per serving instance. Check: H100 at 90/143/197 tok/s/user gives concurrency x interactivity / (tok/s/chip / 9) = 4.0 GPUs per instance at all three points, consistent with a 4-GPU instance. We therefore convert to per-GPU concurrency c = (tok_s_chip / 9) / interactivity.

model_assumptions.per_user_speed: I(c): per-user output tok/s at c concurrent requests per GPU, log-log interpolated between benchmark points; flat (= highest benchmarked interactivity) below the lowest concurrency; above the highest benchmarked concurrency aggregate output may grow at most 15%.
model_assumptions.request_time: baseLatency + uncached_input / prefill_tps + output / (I(c) x efficiency), with c re-evaluated continuously as requests come and go (processor sharing).
model_assumptions.capacity: Decode-slot capacity at a target interactivity I*: c*(I*) x I* output tok/s per GPU. Conservative: benchmark requests carry an 8k-token prefill per 1k output; measured agent requests carry ~3 uncached input tokens per output token.
model_assumptions.prefill_tps: Assumed per-request prefill speed (uncached tokens/s): H100 10k, H200 12k, B200 25k. Not benchmarked here; contributes ~0.1-0.5 s per request.
model_assumptions.cached_tokens: Prefix-cache hits are treated as free (cachedWorkWeight 0); adjustable.
model_assumptions.h100_tp1: vLLM recipe: TP=1 on H100 needs --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95; KV cache is tight, hence the lower concurrency cap.

h100.label: 1x H100 80GB (TP1)
h100.max_concurrency_note: KV-cache bound (assumption): ~8 GB free after 65 GB fp4 weights at 0.95 memory utilisation; ~37 KB/token (18 full-attention layers x 8 KV heads x 64 dim x bf16 K+V; sliding-window layers negligible) -> ~220k tokens -> ~24 agent contexts of ~9k tokens.

h200.label: 1x H200 141GB (TP1)
h200.max_concurrency_note: Batch-size cap (assumption); KV cache (~65 GB free) is not binding for ~9k-token agent contexts.

b200.label: 1x B200 180GB (TP1)
b200.max_concurrency_note: Batch-size cap (assumption). vLLM recipe: B200 max throughput with TP=1.

facts: gpt-oss-120b: 116.83B total / 5.13B active parameters, MoE 128 experts top-4, MXFP4 MoE weights, ~60.8 GiB checkpoint, 131k context; fits on a single 80 GB GPU (OpenAI model card).
vLLM recipe: TP=1 works on H100 with --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 --max-num-batched-tokens 1024; for B200 max throughput use TP=1.
